beats.summary: Michael impersonates 'Prison Mike' to humorously describe prison life with exaggerated and absurd details.

evidence.snippet: I'm prison Mike! You know why they call me prison Mike?!
The worst thing about prison was the… was the Dementors. They… were flying all over the place, and they were scary.

beats.summary: Michael locks the employees in the conference room to teach them a lesson about appreciating freedom after they mock his prison stories.

evidence.snippet: No! If you think is prison is so wonderful, then, enjoy prison!

beats.summary: Toby calls Michael to intervene and insists on letting the employees out, explaining they were teasing Michael and that the office is much better than prison.

evidence.snippet: Toby: Well, you're going to have to let 'em out. Or… or I will.
Toby: You know they're teasing you. I mean… obviously, this is… a much nicer place than an actual prison.

beats.summary: Michael releases the employees from the conference room and sarcastically praises them for their 'good behavior' and freedom.

evidence.snippet: Michael (unlocks door): Okay nutcases, get out of there! Good work.
Time off for good behavior! Heh. Good job. Enjoy your freedoms!

beats.summary: Michael reflects on Martin's changing role in the office, from new guy to convict to nuisance to quitter, denying racial bias in his opinion.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Martin went from being a new guy from Stamford… to a convict, to… my friend.
And I will not miss him. And that is not because he is black.
